task_name: Lineage bootstrap, upstream audit, partition firewall, and TRAIN-CV freeze
notes: Control-plane/data-governance/pre-registration phase. No MODEL_V2 training occurs. Establishes the MODEL_V2 namespace, partition firewall, frozen TRAIN-only outer-CV and inner-validation manifests, and the hash-locked MODEL_V2_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL_V1 before any new neural-model outcome is generated.
5 outer folds x 3 seeds = 15 reference fits of the existing frozen MODEL_V1 architecture/training recipe on MITDB_TRAIN_CV_V2_V1, establishing the baseline the V2 architecture search must beat.
Feature-ablation of BASELINE_FEATURES_V1 (STAT/RR/QRS/combinations) with frozen-config LR/RF on the TRAIN-CV manifest, establishing the hybrid trigger threshold and minimal adequate feature subset.

3 architectures (MODEL_V2_CAPCTRL, MODEL_V2_TCN_MEAN, MODEL_V2_TCN_MEANMAX) x 5 folds x 3 seeds = 45 fits against the matched V1 CV reference, screened by the pre-registered practical-improvement rule.
Runs ONLY if the classical feature-information hybrid trigger (Section 8H) fires; otherwise SKIPPED_BY_PROTOCOL.
One predeclared CONTROL vs CHALLENGER optimizer/scheduler comparison on the winning architecture family only; no grid search.

At most two frozen configurations trained from scratch on all 27 TRAIN patient groups, evaluated once on official VALIDATION, 3 seeds each. First official VALIDATION access freezes all further architecture/hyperparameter/search-rule changes.
Promotion requires release-seed VALIDATION AUPRC >= 0.5628608 (V1 release AUPRC + 0.03) with three-seed confirmation and no material AUROC regression.
Single positive scalar temperature fit on CALIBRATION only, after MODEL_V2_FINAL is frozen; MIT-BIH source-domain calibration claim only.

One pass each on INTERNAL_TEST/INCART/NSTDB (previously exposed evaluation domains), labeled as post-freeze comparative second-look evidence, never as untouched V2 validation. Runtime-acceptance guardrails evaluated here.
Error analysis on the frozen V2 second-look outputs; mirrors T031/C031 in spirit without retuning MODEL_V2_FINAL or CAL_V2.
Only if runtime-acceptance guardrails pass: GATEWAY_ARTIFACT_V2 export and equivalence benchmark, additive to (never mutating) GATEWAY_ARTIFACT_V1.
Additive API_RUNTIME_V2 binding and replay evidence; investigate whether the existing frontend is already model-ID-generic before versioning it.
Clean-environment reproducibility proof for the full MODEL_V2 lineage, mirroring T035/C035 discipline.
